other_conditions: Father or mother (or both) must be registered as a construction worker in the Board for at least one year
Parents must have worked as a construction worker for at least 90 days in the year preceding the application date
The daughter must not be registered in any division under the Labor Department
Only two daughters of a registered construction worker family are eligible for the incentive
The daughter must have passed at least 10th class
The daughter must have a running bank account in her name
Beneficiaries who have already received assistance under Minimata Kanya Vivah Yojana or Rajmata Vijayaraje Kanya Vivah Assistance Yojana are not eligible
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹20,000 for the first two girl children.
